lines.en: Hello. I'm Yuna Kim, a Korean-American.

lines.beaver_en: Did you spend your growing years abroad?
lines.en: Yes, I grew up in Seattle.

lines.beaver_en: What did you do at your previous company?
lines.learner: 최연소 팀장으로 인적 자원 관리를 맡았습니다.
lines.en: As the youngest team leader, I managed human resources.
lines.roman: Choeyeonso timjangeuro injeok jawon gwallireul matasseumnida.

lines.beaver: 최연소 팀장이라니 대단하시네요. 몇 살 때였습니까?
lines.beaver_en: The youngest leader, impressive. How old were you?
lines.beaver_roman: Choeyeonso timjangirani daedanhasineyo. Myeot sal ttaeyeotseumnikka?
lines.learner: 스물여섯 살 때였습니다. 차곡차곡 경력을 쌓았죠.
lines.en: I was twenty-six. I built my career step by step.
lines.roman: Seumullyeoseot sal ttaeyeotseumnida. Chagokchagok gyeongnyeogeul ssaatjyo.

lines.beaver: 저희 팀에는 연배가 높은 직원이 많은데 괜찮으십니까?
lines.beaver_en: Our team has many senior staff. Is that okay?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeohui timeneun yeonbaega nopeun jigwoni maneunde gwaenchaneusimnikka?
lines.en: Of course. I respect my seniors' experience.

lines.beaver_en: Won't conflicts arise since you're a young leader?
lines.learner: 대화를 중시하니 갈등이 오래갈 턱이 없습니다.
lines.en: I value dialogue, so conflicts can't possibly last long.
lines.roman: Daehwareul jungsihani galdeungi oraegal teogi eopseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: You wrote 'feminine leadership' in your application.
lines.learner: 네, 부드럽게 소통하는 리더십이 제 강점입니다.
lines.en: Yes, gentle, communicative leadership is my strength.
lines.roman: Ne, budeureopge sotonghaneun rideosibi je gangjeomimnida.

lines.beaver: 저희 일은 야근이 많아 힘들 수 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Our work has lots of overtime, so it can be hard.
lines.beaver_roman: Jeohui ireun yageuni mana himdeul su itseumnida.
lines.learner: 체력에는 자신 있습니다. 잘 해낼 수 있습니다.
lines.en: I'm confident in my stamina. I can handle it.
lines.roman: Cheryeogeneun jasin itseumnida. Jal haenael su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Anything you'd like to say at the end?
lines.learner: 인사 관리에서 꼭 좋은 성과를 내겠습니다.
lines.en: I will surely achieve good results in HR management.
lines.roman: Insa gwallieseo kkok joeun seonggwareul naegetseumnida.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 결과는 다음 주에 알려 드리겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Good. We'll let you know the result next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Jotseumnida. Gyeolgwaneun daeum jue allyeo deurigetseumnida.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll look forward to good news.
